prompt: Abeg, wetin be the time wey polling unit dey open and close for election day?
response: Section 46(1) of the Electoral Act, 2026, talk say the Presiding Officer go open the empty ballot box or present the voting device before accreditation and voting start. After that, the box go be closed and sealed so no one else go open am. Section 46(2) also talk say the ballot box go be put in full view of all present and dey remain so until the poll close. So, the polling unit dey open before accreditation and voting start, and dey close and seal after that.
